hypothesis: The WP510 implementation may incorrectly establish recipient completeness by comparing only the count of UPTAKEN recipients to the count of supplied re-entry bindings, allowing duplicate bindings for one recipient to mask a missing binding for another UPTAKEN recipient.
counterhypothesis: The implementation derives a canonical recipient->binding map, rejects duplicate recipient bindings, and requires exact set equality between UptakeSummary.uptaken_cell_ids and the recipient_cell_id set of validated WP508 bindings.
why_high_information: WP507 and WP508 validate individual receipt/binding lineage, but the WP510 claim adds a new cross-recipient completeness invariant. Cardinality-only aggregation is a common integration failure that component-local tests cannot falsify.

fixture: Build one exact WP506 selection/broadcast addressed to G1 and G2.
Create valid WP507 DELIVERED+UPTAKEN receipts for both G1 and G2 and a canonical UptakeSummary whose uptaken_cell_ids is exactly [G1,G2].
Create valid WP508 re-entry witness/binding A for G1.
Create a second individually valid but distinct WP508 re-entry witness/binding B that is also for G1, using a distinct binding_id/provenance where the upstream ABI permits it.
Supply bindings [A,B] to the WP510 seal while omitting every G2 binding.
preregistered_discriminator.forbidden_result: Any accepted causal-path seal, even if len(bindings)==len(uptaken_cell_ids).
preregistered_discriminator.secondary_assertion: A control fixture with exactly one valid binding for each UPTAKEN recipient must remain admissible at repository-integration scope.

additional_boundary: Set equality must be checked after validating each concrete binding against its exact witness, WP507 receipt, plan, selection, broadcast and CellInput. Caller-supplied recipient labels or binding object counts are not sufficient lineage evidence.
next_exact_action: When the canonical WP510 implementation branch appears, implement this discriminator as REVIEW_ONLY without modifying WP510-owned source. Run exact-head repository CI. If it fails as preregistered, preserve the run/job/head as negative evidence and hand the repair to the sole WP510 mutation authority; if it passes, record the falsifier as NOT_REPRODUCED_AT_TESTED_IDENTITY.
